assessment.criterion_1_all_four_leagues: YES - documented, all four appear BOTH in the xG coverage league list (PL 8, La Liga 564, Liga MX 743, MLS 779) and in the general coverage matrix with Match Statistics = YES
assessment.criterion_1_season_visibility_2026_27: UNVERIFIED - no key, so /seasons could not be called. No plan-scoped season restriction is documented anywhere; the documented restriction is on LEAGUE COUNT and on history older than three seasons, not on the current season. This is the single thing to prove before paying.
assessment.criterion_2_stats: DOCUMENTED - 97 statistic type codes at fixture scope covering team level (SHOTS_TOTAL, SHOTS_ON_TARGET, BALL_POSSESSION, CORNERS, YELLOWCARDS, ...) and player level (MINUTES_PLAYED, RATING, TOUCHES, KEY_PASSES, ...). Per-league presence UNVERIFIED.
assessment.criterion_3_xg: DOCUMENTED for all four leagues, at team, player AND shot level, 13 expected types incl. EXPECTED_GOALS, EXPECTED_GOALS_ON_TARGET, EXPECTED_NON_PENALTY_GOALS, EXPECTED_POINTS. POST-MATCH on xG Basic ("immediately after match completion"). Pre-match xG is NOT offered - which is the safe answer for this repo.
assessment.criterion_4_history: core stats: three seasons included, deeper for a one-time EUR 29+ fee. xG: 2024/25 ONWARDS ONLY - roughly two completed seasons per league. This is the recommendation's sharpest limitation.
assessment.criterion_5_contract: YES - versioned REST API, documented rate limits with 429 semantics, published ToS permitting storage and non-resale use
assessment.criterion_6_identity: stable integer ids (fixture_id, participant/team id, player_id) reused across endpoints. NO ESPN cross-reference field - a bridge must be built, as was already done for ESPN<->Sportec players in MLS.
assessment.criterion_7_cost: Starter EUR 29/mo (5 leagues, we need 4) + xG Basic EUR 19/mo = EUR 48/mo = EUR 576/yr monthly-billed; roughly EUR 40/mo = EUR 480/yr on annual billing. Rate headroom: 2,000 calls/entity/hour vastly exceeds ~1,520 fixtures/season plus in-season polling.
